The EXECVE arguments decode to `sed -i 's/#!/bin/sh/#!/bin/sh\n/usr/bin/zmcontrolleer \&\n/' /usr/share/awffull/awffull`, which uses in-place sed to modify a script that is executed by the system and inject a line launching an unknown binary (`/usr/bin/zmcontrolleer`) that is run in the background.
